authorization: Miguel activates revision 1; complete one bounded study, leave unmerged. No outreach, automatic merge, workflow dispatch or further campaign.

blinding.engine: Unchanged Suite1 CPython3.12 staged runner: sanitized anonymous train/validation payload only; no block/law label, seed, generator, evaluator, history, oracle or heldout. Public noise threshold is visible.
blinding.evaluator: Private truth/heldout created by generator, first consumed by evaluator after committed selection seal.
blinding.known_information: Designer knows law families and the disclosed Suite1 retrospective metrics. This is informed design, not global outcome blindness.
blinding.limitation: Trusted operator and same OS identity; commitments do not prove absence of unlogged private work.

chronology: sole-file preregistration commit with snapshot as parent
sole-file seed commitment published and read back
one generation: public inputs/eligibility plus private hashes committed
all selections and decisions committed before evaluator reveal
forward explicit-key routing, report and final exact-head CI

design.analysis_unit: Four independent random blocks with deterministic exponent strata; six matched law/noise conditions within each. Not 24 independent replicates, not identically distributed population sampling.
design.matching: Within each block share coefficient, exact features and normalized row noise across both laws and all noise levels. Across splits and blocks streams are distinct.
design.noise_rationale: Suite1 fixed-residual curvature critical range 0.0012542-0.0016277 informs design. For log z uniform [-1,1], beta=0.01 gives curvature RMS beta*sqrt(4/45)=0.00298142 after intercept fit in the population; adding independent uniform log noise gives approximate boundary epsilon=R/sqrt(4-1/3)=0.001557. Finite training intercept and matched cross terms change realized results. Freeze 0.0001 detectable, 0.0016 transition, 0.005 likely nondetection. No guarantee or population inference.
design.rationale: Small balanced 2 x 3 x 4 design supplied by work order. Measures coarse transition and 0/1-3/4 block behavior; no expansion for favorable outcomes.
design.stratification: Block i uses exponent i, exactly once, fixed before outcomes. No random assignment or rerolls.

environment.external_dependencies: Python standard library only, existing internal discovery modules. No external symbolic-regression engine. DM-090 remains deferred; environment boundary unchanged.

evaluation.aggregation: Each condition/noise: 4 expected blocks, recognition/missed-inadequacy/control-rejection counts, stable-wrong counts, approximation and structural-credit counts. Across noise within each block record nonmonotonic false->true recognition explicitly. All 24 retained. No confidence intervals or population false-positive rate.
evaluation.credit: Only rank1 selected stable oracle-matching adequate truth can receive credit, with train/validation/heldout <= policy bound, coefficient error <= coefficient_relative_error_max, no leakage/nuisance. Curved candidates get no credit even if stable and predictive. Wrong stable selections are measured detector limitations, not integrity failures unless granted structural credit.

dispositions.COMPLETE: All 24 nonempty interpretable records, all frozen metrics and integrity/chronology/credit controls valid; irrespective of favorable detector performance.
dispositions.FAIL: Established integrity, leakage, chronology or wrong-credit violation.
dispositions.NO_GO: No interpretable dataset due to capability/operational failure; no disguised poor score.
dispositions.PARTIAL: Integrity sound, 1-23 interpretable records; retain and account for missing/failed cases.
dispositions.UNRESOLVED: Necessary evidence unavailable or frozen scientific interpretation ambiguous; no replacement epoch.

metrics: heldout minimum across sealed fitted candidates (evaluation only)
signed family and rank1 margin r-bound, ratio r/bound
family critical epsilon and dimensionless critical/original noise
unjustified family rejection and rank1 abstention in adequate condition
approximation separately from exact/equivalent oracle match
all candidate class metrics and structural credit
evaluation.performance_requirements: None for completion. Low-noise failure, high-noise nondetection, adequate-control rejection or nonmonotonic recognition are outcomes to report, not reasons to retune.
evaluation.primary: Nonempty exhaustive candidate family; sealed minimum validation error > m*known epsilon+delta denotes family inadequacy. Empty search is capability failure. Equality adequate.
evaluation.selection: Rank1 stable_candidate/no_stable_law is sealed separately; no lower-rank oracle rescue.

generation.failure: Exclusive stage markers and writes. No retries, dropped samples, replacement seed, criterion changes or additional blocks after outcomes. Retain all partial writes and operational failures.
generation.noise: target=exp(log clean+epsilon*u), u uniform [-1,1]; epsilon is known half-width, not standard deviation. Features exact. Actual observations regenerated once at each frozen noise condition, using matched u.
generation.proof: At fixed x,t every admitted monomial is affine in log z; curved truth has nonzero second derivative 2*beta. Features contain no curvature alias.
generation.seed: One secrets.token_hex(32). Commit SHA256(UTF8 margin1:+seed) alone after source freeze; publish branch head and read back before generate. Block seed=SHA256(UTF8 seed+:margin1:block:+zero-based block). Stream=existing SHA256 Stream(block_seed, split+:inputs or split+:noise); law stream for coefficient/centers. Same normalized u reused across conditions.

grammar.coefficient: exp(mean training log(target)-log(monomial))); never refit on validation/heldout
grammar.enumeration: Existing neutral-value dimensional enumerator, exact dependency expansion, equivalence classes, expanded exponent complexity, nullspace diagnostic. No sums, logarithms, exponentials or fractional powers in candidate language; logs are used only for fitting/scoring.
grammar.equivalence: Expand operational monomial aliases to atomic exponent signatures; one class, no alias complexity discount. Oracle law is never added to feature metadata.
grammar.family: positive dimensionless coefficient times monomial of at most three registered feature surfaces

nonclaims: No discovery of unknown natural laws
No universal false-positive rate or population statistical inference
No superiority over external symbolic-regression systems
No empirical evidence for any Number Project physical hypothesis
No hostile-code sandbox or human family blindness
Finite-data family rejection does not uniquely identify wrong grammar outside this known-truth design
question: With fixed grammar and decision rule, how does observed family-inadequacy recognition change as fixed curvature becomes small relative to known generated noise?

retrospective.paths: Suite1 preregistration, oracle_reveal (noise labels only), input policies and sealed selection records; explicit disposition index. No generation, fit or discovery.
retrospective.rank1: Compute separate rank1 critical and stability; do not substitute complexity-ranked top error for family minimum.
retrospective.rule: critical=(minimum raw validation RMSE - numeric_floor)/adequacy_noise_multiplier; inadequacy iff assumed epsilon>=0 and raw error > m*epsilon+delta; equality adequate.
retrospective.zero_noise: critical/original epsilon null if epsilon=0; nonpositive critical means no nonnegative assumed epsilon declares inadequacy.

routing: New study-local explicit-key index references immutable accepted global v2 route; raw, optional operational failures, reconciliation and study conclusion distinct. Never mutate old global index or historical bytes.

scoring.abstention: No rescue by an oracle-selected lower-ranked candidate. Empty enumeration means no candidate capability, not recognized misspecification.
scoring.adequacy: Bound = adequacy_noise_multiplier * known epsilon + numeric_floor; same rule for all cells. Stable selected candidate only if rank-1 validation RMSE <= bound. The smallest raw validation RMSE across the exhaustive eligible family is checked separately. If all exceed bound, seal family_inadequate_on_validation. This is finite-data adequacy, not proof of the unique cause of failure.
scoring.all_candidate_reporting: For every class, report validation/heldout RMSE, both adequacy and approximation survival, oracle match, nuisance/leakage flags, exact/alias recovery type, evidence class. Counts are designed-suite counts only.
scoring.approximation: Seal top predictive_approximation if validation RMSE <= approximation_rmse_max, independently of adequacy and without structural credit. After reveal, test heldout against the same approximation bound.
scoring.rank: validation natural-log RMSE + lambda * expanded exponent L1 complexity, ties complexity then canonical class ID
scoring.robustness: Preserve pre-reveal leave-one-atomic-group-out scores and descendant removals from existing engine. Nuisance success requires selected class unchanged and still stable after each of n0,n1,q removals; selected class cannot contain any irrelevant atom. Heldout intervenes on q.

validation.final: Focused tests, relevant new artifact/history guard, git diff --check, exact-head protected CI. Work order limits local unrelated suite repetition; full existing Python suite runs once in required CI; no manual unrelated mutations, Lean or old-world regeneration.
validation.preflight: Independent deterministic fixtures before target seed; generator formulas/matching/strata tested on different numerical policy and fixture seed. Forward adapter consumes explicit-key route, never old make_index.
required: threshold equality and flip including zero noise/nonpositive critical
training-only fit and heldout cannot change seal
matched dependence and block stream separation
live receipt/cache and leakage poison regressions
validation.same_epoch_replay: New study guard may regenerate known revealed seed and re-evaluate metrics for reproduction only; discovery replay only if needed. Never count as fresh evidence.
